title: Myanmar's Rare Earth Gamble
description: Why is Myanmar lobbying the US to invest in its rare earth mines, and what makes this geopolitical chess game so complicated? We break down the mining stakes, rebel control, and supply chain realities.

seo.title: Why the US Wants Myanmar's Rare Earths
seo.description: Myanmar sits on massive rare earth deposits, but rebel-controlled mines and a brutal civil war complicate its push to sell directly to the US instead of relying on China's dominance. The Pentagon has lifted sanctions for talks, yet processing capacity and security risks remain huge hurdles; this strategic gamble could reshape global supply chains or collapse before delivery begins.
